metadata.title: CLPS lunar landing sites
metadata.coordinateConvention: Latitude/longitude decimal degrees. Coordinates are populated only when an official source supplies them.
metadata.classificationRule: confirmed_landing_site means a CLPS lander actually touched down there; proposed_target_site means a planned/target destination with no confirmed landing from that mission.
metadata.sourcePolicy: NASA official sources only; unknown coordinates are TBD.

confirmedLandingSites.name: Malapert A region
confirmedLandingSites.notes: Odysseus (IM-1) landed in the Malapert A region; the listed coordinates are the lander location, not a generalized center of the whole region.

confirmedLandingSites.name: Mare Crisium, near Mons Latreille
confirmedLandingSites.notes: Blue Ghost Mission 1 landed near Mons Latreille in Mare Crisium.

confirmedLandingSites.name: Mons Mouton region
confirmedLandingSites.coordinateSource: NASA PDS instrument-host record and NASA NSSDC
confirmedLandingSites.notes: Athena (IM-2) landed in the Mons Mouton region; its near-horizontal final orientation limited some payload operations.

proposedTargetSites.name: Sinus Viscositatis
proposedTargetSites.notes: Peregrine's intended destination; the spacecraft did not land, so this is not a confirmed landing site.

proposedTargetSites.name: Reiner Gamma
proposedTargetSites.notes: NASA-listed target for the IM-3 delivery; do not plot as a touchdown location until confirmed.

proposedTargetSites.name: Lunar far side (specific site TBD)
proposedTargetSites.notes: NASA describes a far-side delivery; a specific surface coordinate is not provided in the cited summary.

proposedTargetSites.name: Schrödinger Basin
proposedTargetSites.notes: NASA provider information identifies Schrödinger Basin as the target; exact touchdown coordinates are TBD.

proposedTargetSites.name: Gruithuisen Domes
proposedTargetSites.notes: NASA-listed target for Blue Ghost Mission 3; not a confirmed landing.

proposedTargetSites.name: Mons Mouton
proposedTargetSites.notes: NASA lists Mons Mouton as the target for CP-22/IM-4; this is separate from the earlier IM-2 touchdown record in the same broad region.

proposedTargetSites.name: Lunar South Pole (specific site TBD)
proposedTargetSites.notes: NASA lists a South Pole delivery target; exact landing coordinates are TBD.
